What happened:


App: <name and version, from Settings>
iDrive 7 or 8, firmware <train, e.g. P18_23w44.2-1-3, if you know it>

The quickest way: in the app, Settings, Send a report. It fills all of this in for you and shows a QR code for
your phone. Never post your VIN, location or anything personal here unless you mean to.
